name: V4 body and caps — Engineering Plate, PETG Translucent + PLA Translucent, 560 mm3 changeover
confirmation: User confirmed 0.6 mm High Flow, PETG AMS slot 4, PLA AMS slot 2 on 2026-09-13.
colour_source: Bambu Studio's selected translucent material colours; display colours do not bind AMS slots.
flush_source: User clarified that the print used PETG Translucent with PLA and requested alternate V4 body/cap files after authorizing the 560 mm3 / 12 mm3/s changeover calibration.
exceptions: Resolve complete installed translucent filament presets instead of the Tinmorry/PLA Basic recipes. Keep nozzle variant columns, original geometry and shared role/support policies.

Shared-bed override: set PLA's textured plate settings to the PETG model's 70 C for both first and other layers. The body slice emitted 55 C during an early material change even with by_first_filament. Verify actual bed commands remain 70 C until shutdown. All nozzle, flow, cooling and retraction settings retain the native translucent recipes.
Use Bambu's explicit allow-mix-temp CLI option for the intentional PETG/PLA support pair. Neither material is relabelled or assigned a false support-material identity.

Body surface exception: Classic with thin-wall detection and outer-first ordering removes the measured 0.52-to-1.09 mm exterior bead-width variation at the D6 covers. Precise outer wall is disabled because Bambu ignores it for outer-first ordering. Qualify complete exterior coverage, D6 retaining continuity and insertion timing from the final slice. Caps and wings retain their existing Arachne process.

AMS slots are print-send mappings. Native filament_map/nozzle_map vectors identify the single physical nozzle, not AMS slots. Bind material 1 to slot 4 and material 2 to slot 2 in Bambu Studio's Send dialog.
Alternate changeover calibration: 560 mm3 each direction, multiplier 1, explicit 12 mm3/s PLA flush. Printing temperature and printing flow limits retain the translucent recipes.

Engineering Plate with glue: both filament engineering-plate temperatures are 70 C. No raft; 5 mm outer brim. Bottom support gap is zero; the mutual-support guide excludes these translucent filaments, so this remains a custom qualification.

plate.adhesion: User-confirmed glue; 5 mm outer brim; no raft

guide_review.applied: PETG support base; PLA interface; three dense interface layers; zero top and bottom Z gaps; no raft. Keep prime tower and no contaminated flushing into model or supports.
guide_review.qualification: Outside the guide: it explicitly excludes PETG Translucent and only covers PLA Basic with PETG HF/Basic. Engineering Plate is not one of its listed plates.
guide_review.material_exception: Retain the user-selected PETG Translucent / PLA Translucent recipes (PETG 250/245 C, PLA 220 C) and Engineering Plate with glue at 70 C; do not claim the guide's 60 C / PLA Basic 230 C process is validated for these filaments.
guide_review.geometry_exception: Keep qualified snug supports, bed-only scope, 0.7 mm XY clearance and fixed 0.16 mm support layers instead of copying the guide's 0.4 mm tree-support template; these protect insert/cable bores and cap ceiling coverage.
guide_review.cooling_exception: Keep native translucent P2S cooling; the downloaded guide P2S recipe is for PLA Basic/PETG HF and must not overwrite the full translucent recipes.
guide_review.operator: Dry each material using its own supplier instructions; ventilate the P2S by opening the door and/or top cover while PLA is in use.
